#################################################################################################### 
Purpose: This script integrates and tidies all the data per pathogen; specifically, this script 
brings together the processed participant, vaccination, and serology data with the vaccine 
concentrations and spatial and climate data for all the included studies per pathogen. Then, 
exclusions per group and per participant.

Functions Used:
- `fun_dgsk_vacconco.R`: Function to create data frame of concomitant vaccines.
- `fun_dgsk_vacimm.R`: Function to process and tidy immunogenicity data relative to vaccination doses, including time differences, baseline values, and censoring status

Output:
- `stu_ppat.rds`:  List of data frames with all the included participants with all data on 
vaccination and immunogenicity. 
- `stu_ppat_checks.rds`:  Data frame with information on the number of studies and participants
excluded per criteria. 
####################################################################################################

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("00_pck.R")
source("fun_data/fun_dgsk_vacconco.R")
source("fun_data/fun_dgsk_vacimm.R")
```

# 1. Load preliminary data =========================================================================

# Load the data frame of included studies per pathogen
```{r}
stu_perpat <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_included_perpat.rds")) %>%
  filter(included == TRUE) %>%
  select(pat, study)
```

# Load data frames of vaccine names and serology names
```{r}
# Obtain the tidy vaccine names from the processed data 
stu_vaccines <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_tidynames_vaccines.rds")) %>%
  # Filter out missing or placebo vaccine entries
  filter(!is.na(vaccine_tidy) & vaccine_tidy != "placebo") %>%
  # Split the vaccine names by pathogen group
  separate_longer_delim(vaccine_tidy, delim = "_") %>%
  distinct(vaccine_tidy) %>%
  mutate(pat = case_when(
    str_detect(vaccine_tidy, "strep") ~ "strep",
    str_detect(vaccine_tidy, "dtp") ~ "dipht_tetan_pertu",
    str_detect(vaccine_tidy, "mmr") ~ "measl_mumps_rubel",
    str_detect(vaccine_tidy, "measl") ~ "measl",
    str_detect(vaccine_tidy, "ipv|opv") ~ "polio",
    .default = vaccine_tidy)) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(pat, delim = "_")
# Create list of vaccine names per pathogen
stu_vaccines <- split(stu_vaccines$vaccine_tidy, stu_vaccines$pat)

# Obtain the tidy serology names from the processed data
stu_seronames <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_tidynames_seronames.rds")) %>%
  # Filter out screening tests
  filter(!(seroname_tidy %in% c(
    "anti_protd", "anti_protply", "scr_saureus", "scr_spyogenes", "scr_paeruginosa", "scr_hiv", 
    "scr_spneumoniae", "scr_mcatarrhalis", "scr_cd4cellsperc", "scr_cd4cellsconc", "anti_hiv",
    "anti_rota_iga_rix", "anti_rota_igg", "anti_rota_igtot", "anti_hbv_core")) & 
      !is.na(seroname_tidy)) %>%
  distinct(seroname_tidy) %>%
  # Tidy up pathogen names to match pathogen group names
  mutate(pat = case_when(
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "strep") ~ "strep", 
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "polio") ~ "polio", 
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "pertu") ~ "pertu",
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "rota") ~ "rota", 
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "men") ~ "men", 
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "hbv") ~ "hbv", 
    .default = seroname_tidy),
    pat = str_remove(pat, "anti_"))
# Create list of serology names per pathogen
stu_seronames <- split(stu_seronames$seroname_tidy, stu_seronames$pat)
```

# Extract serology cutoffs from data and fixes unclear values based on protocols.
```{r}
# Extract cutoffs for each pathogen (from serology data)
stu_cutoffs <- sapply(names(stu_seronames), function(x) {
  readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_tidynames_seronames.rds")) %>%
    filter(study %in% filter(stu_perpat, pat == x)$study) %>%
    filter(seroname_tidy %in% stu_seronames[[x]]) %>%
    rename(imm_cutoff = cut_off,
           imm_sero = seroname_tidy,
           imm_met = method_tidy) %>%
    distinct(study, imm_met, imm_sero, imm_cutoff)
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  # Combine all pathogen-specific data into a single data frame
  bind_rows(.id = "pat") %>%
  # Fixing cutoffs based on protocol information
  mutate(imm_cutoff = case_when(
    pat == "dipht" & study %in% c("201330") & imm_cutoff == "0.057" ~ "0.1",
    pat == "hbv" & 
      study %in% c("201330", "113994", "111634", "111157", "113615", "103860-277", "112157") & 
      imm_cutoff %in% c("3.3", "6.2") ~ "10",
    pat == "hib" & study %in% c("201330") & imm_cutoff == "0.066" ~ "0.15",
    pat == "mumps" &
      study %in% c("111870", "208136-038", "108760", "110876", "110058") & imm_cutoff %in% c("24") ~ "28",
    pat == "pertu" & imm_sero == "anti_pertu_fha" &
      study %in% c("201330", "104567") & imm_cutoff %in% c("2.046", "20") ~ "5",
    pat == "pertu" & imm_sero == "anti_pertu_prn" &
      study %in% c("201330", "104567") & imm_cutoff %in% c("2.187", "20") ~ "5",
    pat == "pertu" & imm_sero == "anti_pertu_pt" &
      study %in% c("201330", "217744-085", "113994", "759348-007", "111157", "112921", "103488",
                   "444563-005", "811936-001", "711202-001", "444563-007", "347414-023",
                   "759348-003", "759348-001", "347414-020", "217744-070", "112640", "113615", 
                   "107005", "105553", "103974", "101858", "792014-003", "792014-001", "114260",
                   "113808", "102247", "107017", "107058", "105554", "105539", "217744-069", 
                   "106208", "104871", "101197", "217744-078", "217744-076", "106786", "217744-097",
                   "217744-077", "105910", "111654", "109861", "104567", "112157") & 
      imm_cutoff %in% c("2.693", "5", "20") ~ "15",
    pat == "rota" & study %in% c("115461") & imm_cutoff %in% c("13") ~ "20",
    pat == "tetan" & study %in% c("201330") & imm_cutoff == "0.043" ~ "0.1", 
    pat == "vzv" & imm_met == "elisa" &
      study %in% c("115648", "115555", "111870", "100388", "108760", "109705", "110058") & 
      imm_cutoff %in% c("25") ~ "50",
    .default = imm_cutoff),
    imm_cutoff = as.numeric(imm_cutoff)) %>%
  distinct()
```

# 2. Read in the data ==============================================================================
```{r}
# Initialize list to store processed data for each pathogen and store checks 
patdf_l <- list()
patdf_checks <- list()

# Loop through each pathogen and some specific vaccines (ipv, opv, dtpw, dtpa)
for (vac in c(unique(stu_perpat$pat), "ipv", "opv", "dtpw", "dtpa")) {
  
  # Map the vaccines to the correct pathogen name
  i <- case_when(vac %in% c("dtpw", "dtpa") ~ "dipht",
                 vac %in% c("ipv", "opv") ~ "polio",
                 .default = vac)

  # Get the list of studies for the i pathogen
  stu_pat <- filter(stu_perpat, pat == i)$study
  
  # Read in the processed data frames for each included study --------------------------------------
  stu_dfs <- list()
  # Load participant data (pid)
  stu_dfs$pid <- sapply(stu_pat, function(x) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/01_stu_tidydfs/stu_df_pid_{x}.rds"))}, simplify = F)
  # Load vaccine data (expo)
  stu_dfs$expo_all <- sapply(stu_pat, function(x) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/01_stu_tidydfs/stu_df_expo_{x}.rds"))}, simplify = F)
  # Load serology data (sero)
  stu_dfs$sero_all <- sapply(stu_pat, function(x) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/01_stu_tidydfs/stu_df_sero_{x}.rds"))}, simplify = F)
  
  # Tidy participant (pid) data --------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Only need to merge studies 
  stu_dfs$pid <- bind_rows(stu_dfs$pid)
  
  # Tidy vaccination (expo) data ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Process the vaccine data to handle multiple doses and dates for the i pathogen
  stu_dfs$expo <- bind_rows(stu_dfs$expo_all) %>%
    separate_longer_delim(vac_name, delim = "_") %>%
    # Select only vaccination to the i pathogen
    filter(vac_name %in% stu_vaccines[[i]]) %>%
    # Obtain number of doses per individual 
    group_by(study, pid) %>%
    mutate(doses = rank(vac_date)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Pivot wider (vaccine columns)
    select(study, pid, doses, vac_name, vac_date) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = doses, values_from = c(vac_name, vac_date), names_sep = "_v") %>%
    # Calculate the week of first vaccination
    mutate(vac_week_v1 = week(vac_date_v1),
           vac_week_v1 = case_when(vac_week_v1 == 53 ~ 52, .default = vac_week_v1))
  # Ensure no repeats per pid
  stopifnot(length(stu_dfs$expo[[1]]) == length(distinct(stu_dfs$expo, study, pid)[[1]]))
  
  # Tidy concomitant vaccination (expo_conco) data -------------------------------------------------
  # Process the vaccine data to handle concomitant vaccinations (within 15 days) to the
  # vaccination to the i pathogen
  stu_dfs$expo_conco <- fun_dgsk_vacconco(stu_dfs$expo_all, stu_dfs$expo, 
                                          vac_names = stu_vaccines[[i]])
  
  # Tidy serology (sero) data ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Process serology data by selecting only the seronames for the i pathogen and merge with cutoffs 
  stu_dfs$sero <- filter(bind_rows(stu_dfs$sero_all), imm_sero %in% stu_seronames[[i]]) %>%
    left_join(select(filter(stu_cutoffs, pat == i), -pat), by = join_by(study, imm_met, imm_sero))
  
  # Integrate all data -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  patdf_l[[vac]] <- bind_rows(stu_dfs$pid) %>%
    # Combine participant, vaccination, concomitant vaccination, and serology data
    left_join(stu_dfs$expo, by = join_by(study, pid)) %>% 
    left_join(stu_dfs$expo_conco, by = join_by(study, pid)) %>%
    left_join(stu_dfs$sero, by = join_by(study, pid)) %>%
    # Tidy vaccination and immunogenicity activities 
    fun_dgsk_vacimm() %>%
    # Add vaccine concentrations 
    left_join(filter(stu_vacconc, pat == i), by = join_by(study, country, rct_group)) %>%
    # Add spatial and climate data
    left_join(stu_clim, by = join_by(study, country)) 
  
  # Adjustments ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Adjust country names for rotavirus studies
  if(vac == "rota") patdf_l[[vac]] <- mutate(patdf_l[[vac]], country = str_remove_all(country, "_.*"))
  
  # Subset data for Polio and Diphtheria 
  if(vac %in% c("dtpw", "dtpa", "ipv", "opv")) {
    patdf_l[[vac]] <- filter(patdf_l[[vac]], if_all(starts_with("vac_name_v"), ~ . == vac | is.na(.)))}
    
  # Checks -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  patdf_checks[[vac]] <- c(missing_expo = length(setdiff(stu_pat, unique(stu_dfs$expo$study))),
                           missing_sero = length(setdiff(stu_pat, unique(stu_dfs$sero$study))),
                           studies_n = length(unique(patdf_l[[vac]]$study)),
                           pid_n = length(distinct(patdf_l[[vac]], study, pid)[[1]]))
}
# This part can take up to 5 minutes 
# Expect one warning due to min(doses) == 1 for hav 

bind_rows(patdf_checks, .id = "pat")
```

# Group exclusions =================================================================================

# Function to identify missing data per defined level 
```{r}
fun_group_exclusion <- function(dat = patdf_l$measl, 
                                var_name = "age", 
                                level = c("study", "rct_group")) {
  # Arguments:
  # - dat: (data frame) The data frame for which to group according to levels and identify missings.
  # - var_name: (string) The name of the variable to evaluate missings.
  # - level: (vector of strings) Group definition.
  # Output:
  # - dat: (named list of data frames) The data frame specifying groups to be excluded. 
  distinct(dat, across(all_of(c(level, var_name)))) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(level))) %>%
    mutate(!!paste0("na_", var_name) := (n() == 1 & is.na(!!sym(var_name)))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    distinct(across(all_of(c(level, !!paste0("na_", var_name)))))
}

# Define the variables to be used in fun_group_exclusion
var_names <- c("age", "sex", "vac_name_v1", "vac_date_v1", "vac_conc",
               "imm_sero_s1", "imm_date_s1", "imm_val_s1", 
               "imm_sero_s0", "imm_date_s0", "imm_val_s0")
```

# Exception for birth vaccination for hbv (no need for baseline ab)
```{r}
lapply(patdf_l, function(x) distinct(filter(x, (vac_date_v1 - birth_date) < 7), study))
lapply(patdf_l, function(x) distinct(filter(x, age < 1), study))
exphbv_l <- distinct(filter(patdf_l$hbv, (vac_date_v1 - birth_date) < 7), study)
```

# Full studies and RCT groups-countries to be excluded
```{r}
# Identify complete studies missing variables 
exclu_group_l <- list()
exclu_group_l$perstudy <- sapply(names(patdf_l), function(i) {
  reduce(lapply(var_names, function(x) {
    fun_group_exclusion(patdf_l[[i]], var_name = x, level = c("study"))
    }), ~left_join(.x, .y, by = join_by(study)))
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "pat") %>%
  # Exception for hbv studies
  mutate(na_imm_sero_s0 = case_when(study %in% exphbv_l$study ~ FALSE, .default = na_imm_sero_s0),
         na_imm_date_s0 = case_when(study %in% exphbv_l$study ~ FALSE, .default = na_imm_date_s0),
         na_imm_val_s0 = case_when(study %in% exphbv_l$study ~ FALSE, .default = na_imm_val_s0)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(include = all(c_across(starts_with("na")) == FALSE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Identify RCT groups-countries missing variables (other than the complete studies)
exclu_group_l$perrctg <- sapply(names(patdf_l), function(i){
  reduce(lapply(var_names, function(x) {
    fun_group_exclusion(filter(patdf_l[[i]], study %in% 
                                 unique(filter(exclu_group_l$perstudy, include == TRUE)$study)), 
                        var_name = x, level = c("study", "rct_group", "country"))
    }), ~left_join(.x, .y, by = join_by(study, rct_group, country)))
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "pat") %>%
  # 1. Exclude RCT groups that do not fulfill population criteria (e.g., pre-term infants, 
  # sickle cell disease, HIV+)
  # Result: 10 study-RCT group pair excluded
  mutate(na_pop = str_detect(rct_group, "pre-term|pre_term|sickle|hiv \\+")) %>%
  # Exception for hbv studies
  mutate(na_imm_sero_s0 = case_when(study %in% exphbv_l$study ~ FALSE, .default = na_imm_sero_s0),
         na_imm_date_s0 = case_when(study %in% exphbv_l$study ~ FALSE, .default = na_imm_date_s0),
         na_imm_val_s0 = case_when(study %in% exphbv_l$study ~ FALSE, .default = na_imm_val_s0)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(include = all(c_across(starts_with("na")) == FALSE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Identify new excluded studies for all pathogens 
setdiff(unique(exclu_group_l$perstudy$study), 
        unique(filter(exclu_group_l$perstudy, include == TRUE)$study))
# Studies "107005", "111654", "113615" are missing baseline antibodies 
filter(exclu_group_l$perstudy, study %in% c("107005", "111654", "113615"))

setdiff(unique(filter(exclu_group_l$perstudy, include == TRUE)$study),
        unique(filter(exclu_group_l$perrctg, include == TRUE)$study))
# Study 105539 is missing baseline antibodies and age 
filter(exclu_group_l$perrctg, study %in% c("105539"))
```

# Exclude full studies and RCT groups-countries
```{r}
for (i in names(patdf_l)) {
  # Filter out complete studies
  patdf_l[[i]] <- patdf_l[[i]] %>%
    left_join(filter(exclu_group_l$perstudy, pat == i) %>%
                select(study, include), by = join_by(study)) %>%
    filter(include == TRUE) %>%
    select(-include)
  # Update checks 
  patdf_checks[[i]] <- c(patdf_checks[[i]], 
                         pid_exclusion_study = length(distinct(patdf_l[[i]], study, pid)[[1]]),
                         studies_exclusion_study = length(distinct(patdf_l[[i]], study)[[1]]))
  
  # Filter out complete rct_groups-countries
  patdf_l[[i]] <- patdf_l[[i]] %>%
    left_join(filter(exclu_group_l$perrctg, pat == i) %>%
                select(study, rct_group, country, include), 
              by = join_by(study, rct_group, country)) %>%
    filter(include == TRUE) %>%
    select(-include)
  # Update checks 
  patdf_checks[[i]] <- c(patdf_checks[[i]], 
                         pid_exclusion_rctg = length(distinct(patdf_l[[i]], study, pid)[[1]]),
                         studies_exclusion_rctg = length(distinct(patdf_l[[i]], study)[[1]]))
}
bind_rows(patdf_checks, .id = "pathogen")
```

# Participant exclusions ===========================================================================

```{r}
fun_filter_data <- function(data) {
  row_n <- length(data$pid)
  study_n <- length(distinct(data, study)$study)
  pid_n <- length(distinct(data, study, pid)$pid)
  studies <- unique(data$study)
  return(list(row_n = row_n, study_n = study_n, pid_n = pid_n, studies = studies))
}

filter_l <- list()
patdf_row_l <- list()
for (i in names(patdf_l)) {
  
  # Filters
  filter_l$ini[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_l[[i]])
  # Missing age 
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_l[[i]], !is.na(age))
  filter_l$age[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing sex
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(sex))
  filter_l$sex[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing vaccination 
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(vac_name_v1))
  filter_l$vac_name_v1[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing vaccination date
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(vac_date_v1))
  filter_l$vac_date_v1[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing vaccination concentration
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(vac_conc))
  filter_l$vac_conc[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing immunogenicity
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(imm_sero_s1))
  filter_l$imm_sero_s1[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing immunogenicity date
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(imm_date_s1))
  filter_l$imm_date_s1[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing immunogenicity value
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(imm_val_s1))
  filter_l$imm_val_s1[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing immunogenicity method
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(imm_met_s1))
  filter_l$imm_met_s1[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  
  if(i == "hbv") {
  # Missing baseline immunogenicity
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], (!is.na(imm_sero_s0)) |
                               (is.na(imm_sero_s0) & study %in% exphbv_l$study & age < 4))
  filter_l$imm_sero_s0[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing baseline immunogenicity date
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], (!is.na(imm_date_s0)) |
                               (is.na(imm_date_s0) & study %in% exphbv_l$study & age < 4))
  filter_l$imm_date_s0[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing baseline immunogenicity value
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], (!is.na(imm_val_s0)) |
                               (is.na(imm_val_s0) & study %in% exphbv_l$study & age < 4))
  filter_l$imm_val_s0[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing baseline immunogenicity method
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], (!is.na(imm_met_s0)) |
                               (is.na(imm_met_s0) & study %in% exphbv_l$study & age < 4))
  filter_l$imm_met_s0[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  } else {
  # Missing baseline immunogenicity
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(imm_sero_s0))
  filter_l$imm_sero_s0[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing baseline immunogenicity date
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(imm_date_s0))
  filter_l$imm_date_s0[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing baseline immunogenicity value
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(imm_val_s0))
  filter_l$imm_val_s0[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Missing baseline immunogenicity method
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], !is.na(imm_met_s0))
  filter_l$imm_met_s0[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  }
  
  # Eligibility
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], eligibility %in% c(
    "Y", "", "EI_109509", "EI_bo111344", "EI_bo110478", "EI_bo106602","EI_bo104065", "EI_bo111535"))
  filter_l$eligibility[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  # Small time s0 to vaccination (no more than 30 days)
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], time_s0_v1 <= 30)
  filter_l$time_s0_v1[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  
  # Age 
  if(i %in% c("hav", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")) {
    patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], age < 26*4, age >= 4)
    filter_l$age[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  } else {
    patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], age < 6*4, age >= 4)
    filter_l$age[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  }
  
  # Small time vaccination to s1 (no more than 6 months)
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- filter(patdf_row_l[[i]], time_vl_s1 < 30*5)
  filter_l$time_vl_s1[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  
  if(i == "hbv") {
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- patdf_row_l[[i]] %>%
    mutate(imm_val_cutoff_s0 = imm_val_s0 > imm_cutoff_s0) %>%
    group_by(across(-c(imm_val_s0, imm_date_s0, imm_met_s0, imm_sero_s0, imm_cutoff_s0))) %>%
    summarise(
      imm_val_s0_any = any(imm_val_cutoff_s0, na.rm = TRUE),
      imm_val_s0_all = all(imm_val_cutoff_s0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(imm_val_s0_any == FALSE) %>%
    select(-imm_val_s0_any)
  filter_l$imm_val_s0_any[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  } else {
  # Baseline ab titers (measured in any way)
  patdf_row_l[[i]] <- patdf_row_l[[i]] %>%
    mutate(imm_val_cutoff_s0 = imm_val_s0 > imm_cutoff_s0) %>%
    group_by(across(-c(imm_val_s0, imm_date_s0, imm_met_s0, imm_sero_s0, imm_cutoff_s0))) %>%
    summarise(
      imm_val_s0_any = case_when(
        all_na(imm_val_cutoff_s0) == FALSE ~ any(imm_val_cutoff_s0, na.rm = TRUE), .default = NA),
      imm_val_s0_all = case_when(
        all_na(imm_val_cutoff_s0) == FALSE ~ all(imm_val_cutoff_s0, na.rm = TRUE), .default = NA),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(imm_val_s0_any == FALSE) %>%
    select(-imm_val_s0_any)
  filter_l$imm_val_s0_any[[i]] <- fun_filter_data(patdf_row_l[[i]])
  }
}
```

# Check the immunogenicity cut-offs: 
```{r}
# Function to plot the immunogenicity cut-offs
fun_plcutoff <- function(pat = "dipht", method = "elisa", cut_off = 0.1, ncol_pat = 3,
                         sero_spe = NULL, stu_spe = NULL) {
  
  if(!is.null(sero_spe)) {dat <- filter(patdf_row_l[[pat]], imm_sero_s1 == sero_spe) } else {
    dat <- patdf_row_l[[pat]]
  }
  if(!is.null(stu_spe)) dat <- filter(dat, study %in% c(stu_spe))
  
pl_s1 <- dat %>%
  filter(imm_met_s1 == method) %>%
  filter(imm_val_s1 < cut_off) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = imm_val_s1)) + 
  geom_histogram() + 
  facet_wrap(study~., ncol = ncol_pat, strip.position = "right", scales = "free_y") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = cut_off), color = "red")
return(pl_s1)
}
```
